alt: Farah compares shrinking pulse intervals while Demir and Nazari question the forecast.

review.method: Visual inspection of full generated image, tracing all visible limbs and furniture boundaries; canonical face comparison; source story review.
review.notes: Three distinct canonical faces with six coherent arms. Farah uses a control with one hand and rests the other on her lap. Demir holds paper with both hands. Nazari has a hip hand and tablet hand. Shrinking measured intervals remain unresolved.
